name: Cash-Position Forecasting Pipeline – Banking, Invoices & Payment Schedules

parameters.content:
## Cash-Position Forecasting Pipeline

Receives a forecast request, pulls live data from banking, accounts-receivable (invoices) and payment schedules, aggregates the data, and returns a projected cash-position forecast with full audit trail.

### All nodes (1-line each)
1. Webhook - Forecast Request – Receives the cash-position forecast request via POST.
2. Code - Validate & Load Sources – Validates the request and loads data-source configuration + forecast horizon.
3. Wait - Pre Banking Pull – Short pause before banking data retrieval.
4. HTTP Request - Fetch Banking Balances – Pulls current balances and recent transactions from banking APIs.
5. Wait - Pre Invoices Pull – Pause before accounts-receivable / invoice data retrieval.
6. HTTP Request - Fetch Outstanding Invoices – Pulls open invoices and expected collection dates.
7. Wait - Pre Schedules Pull – Pause before payment-schedule data retrieval.
8. HTTP Request - Fetch Payment Schedules – Pulls upcoming AP, payroll, tax and recurring payments.
9. HTTP Request - Enrich / FX Rates – Optional FX rates or external enrichment for multi-currency positions.
10. Code - Build Cash Forecast – Aggregates banking + invoices + schedules into daily/weekly cash-position projection.
11. Respond to Webhook – Returns the complete cash-position forecast report to the caller.

## 1. Intake & Data Sources

Webhook - Forecast Request – Receives the cash-position forecast request via POST.
Code - Validate & Load Sources – Validates the request and loads data-source configuration + forecast horizon.

## 2. Live Data Retrieval

Wait - Pre Banking Pull – Short pause before banking data retrieval.
HTTP Request - Fetch Banking Balances – Pulls current balances and recent transactions from banking APIs.
Wait - Pre Invoices Pull – Pause before accounts-receivable / invoice data retrieval.
HTTP Request - Fetch Outstanding Invoices – Pulls open invoices and expected collection dates.
Wait - Pre Schedules Pull – Pause before payment-schedule data retrieval.
HTTP Request - Fetch Payment Schedules – Pulls upcoming AP, payroll, tax and recurring payments.
HTTP Request - Enrich / FX Rates – Optional FX rates or external enrichment for multi-currency positions.

## 3. Forecast & Respond

Code - Build Cash Forecast – Aggregates banking + invoices + schedules into daily/weekly cash-position projection.
Respond to Webhook – Returns the complete cash-position forecast report to the caller.
